verdict.rationale: Datadog provides an official API Reference and OpenTelemetry integration that developers can build against programmatically, plus an official CLI (datadog-ci) and MCP server, suggesting a broader SDK/tooling ecosystem exists. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents a set of official client SDKs (e.g., per-language libraries) or their AI-specific integration patterns. Missing for 10: explicit SDK documentation pages, language coverage, and any AI-agent-specific SDK usage examples.
